title: Regenerate Scholar Gold icon set from latest reference and update all frontend references

requirements.summary: Regenerate Scholar Gold logo/app-icon/favicons from the latest uploaded reference and add new cache-safe PNG icon assets in standard sizes.
acceptanceCriteria: New PNG icon assets are generated from `Screenshot_2026_0210_153957-1.jpg` and are visually consistent with the uploaded reference (ornate gold ring, navy radial background, book icon, correct title/subtitle).
Generated icon assets use NEW filenames (not the existing `*-v3.*` filenames) to avoid browser caching issues.
At minimum, the generated set includes 512x512, 192x192, and 32x32 PNGs.

file_operations.description: Add newly generated 512x512 Scholar Gold app icon PNG that matches `Screenshot_2026_0210_153957-1.jpg` (ornate gold circular border, deep navy radial background, central gold book icon, “SCHOLAR GOLD” text, “made by PD” subtitle). Filename must be cache-safe and must not reuse any `*-v3.*` name.
Add newly generated 192x192 Scholar Gold app icon PNG matching the latest reference `Screenshot_2026_0210_153957-1.jpg`. Use the new v4 cache-safe filename (do not reuse any `*-v3.*` name).
Add newly generated 32x32 Scholar Gold favicon PNG matching the latest reference `Screenshot_2026_0210_153957-1.jpg`. Use the new v4 cache-safe filename (do not reuse any `*-v3.*` name).

requirements.summary: Update all frontend favicon/app-icon and brand logo references to use the new v4 generated filenames so normal reload shows the updated logo without manual cache clearing.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/index.html` no longer references `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-*-v3.*` and instead references the newly generated cache-safe icon filenames for 32x32, 192x192, and 512x512.

`frontend/src/components/Header.tsx` and `frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx` no longer reference `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v3.dim_512x512.png` and instead reference the newly generated 512x512 icon filename.
After a hard refresh is NOT required: a normal reload shows the updated icon in the browser tab favicon and in both the authenticated header and login header brand mark.

file_operations.description: Replace all Scholar Gold icon link references that currently point to `/assets/generated/*-v3.*` with the new cache-safe filenames: `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-favicon-v4.dim_32x32.png`, `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v4.dim_192x192.png`, and `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v4.dim_512x512.png`.

Update the brand logo `` source to use `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v4.dim_512x512.png` instead of the existing v3 filename so the authenticated header shows the new logo on a normal reload.

Update the login header brand logo `` source to use `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v4.dim_512x512.png` instead of the existing v3 filename so the login screen shows the new logo on a normal reload.
